steps.description:
You can combine AND/OR operators to check multiple conditions. Some examples are shown below:


In the example below, the inner operator will be checked first 
    (Condition 1 OR Condition 2). 
The result will then be used in the outer operator: 
    (Condition 1) AND (result of Condition 1 OR Condition2). 


Be careful that It could be confusing when your condition has too many operators!


Complete the code below by adding the missing condition such that a sound will be made when any of the following happens:
  1. Button D18 is pressed
  2. Buttons D22 and D24 are pressed together
